prompts.a:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset: ONE full-body final-contact frame for a two-pose 2D fighting-game punch.
Input 1 is the ORIGINAL idle identity and costume. Input 2 is the AUTHOR-APPROVED LEFT head hook and graphic style. Draw a matching RIGHT-HAND head hook with the OTHER/NEAR arm, fighter still FACING RIGHT. Do NOT mirror image 2. The RIGHT shoulder/arm is nearest the viewer and rotates across IN FRONT of the chest; left hand remains guarding the far jaw.
Maintain original face, short hair spikes, narrow ugly angular head, short sleeve plain crew-neck T-shirt, loose trousers, boots. Rough irregular black ink, fine dense hatching, muted dusty rose and copper. No hoodie, tall collar, glossy anatomy, caricature muscles, enlarged hair, or new costume.
Anatomy: a clenched fist with STRAIGHT NEUTRAL WRIST, fist and forearm aligned, no limp downward bent wrist. Hook hits HEAD / JAW height, NOT stomach. Elbow elevated near shoulder height, never tucked low like an uppercut. Arm remains BENT at the elbow, not a straight jab. Head watches right; no retreating head or bent neck. The shoulder/hips rotate into the blow; forward boot remains planted in the same place as reference 2. Natural proportional arms, no stretching.
Single pose and fully visible whole body, transparent background and clear margin around hair/fists/boots. No text, no effects, no opponent, no drawn motion lines.
Variant-specific pose: COMPACT HIGH-ELBOW RIGHT HOOK. A tight punch, right upper arm projects slightly toward viewer and is strongly foreshortened. The raised elbow is visibly flared outside, at shoulder/chin height; short horizontal forearm crosses in front of chest, fist at jaw height just beyond the face to the RIGHT. Thumb-up vertical fist, neutral straight wrist. Torso remains relatively upright, right shoulder covers lower jaw; left guard is visible tucked by the far cheek. The silhouette is compact and forceful, not low bent-arm flexing.
